definition: [ כָּשָׂה ] verb be sated, gorged with food (compare Arabic be filled with food ; Assyrian kissatum, sustenance, provender , food , Zephnpf BAS i. 503 ); — only Qal Perfect 2 masculine singular שָׁמַנְתָּ עָבִיתָ כָּשִׂיתָ Deut 32:15 thou grewest fat, becamest thick, wast gorged ! figurative of Israel as fat beast (compare Dr ). כֻּשִׁיִּים כֻּשִׁית see כּוּשִׁי .

[כָּשָׂה] verb be sated, gorged with food (compare Arabic be filled with food; Assyrian kissatum, sustenance, provender, food, ZephnpfBAS i. 503); — only Qal Perfect 2 masculine singular שָׁמַנְתָּ עָבִיתָ כָּשִׂיתָ Deut 32:15 thou grewest fat, becamest thick, wast gorged ! figurative of Israel as fat beast (compare Dr).
